proof_body:
by
  intro K V W _ _ _ _ _ f
  constructor
  · intro hinj x hx
    apply hinj
    simpa using hx
  · intro hzero x y hxy
    have hsub : f (x - y) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero (x - y) hsub)
target_source: ∀ {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K V] [Module K W] (f : V →ₗ[K] W), Function.Injective f ↔ ∀ x, f x = 0 → x = 0
